The TT Can Driver module shall reject configurations with partition mappings which are not supported by the implementation.
These requirements are not applicable to this specification.
The ECUC partitions referenced by CanTTControllerEcucPartitionRef shall be a subset of the ECUC partitions referenced by CanEcucPartitionRef .
CanTTController and CanTrcvChannel of one communication channel shall all reference the same ECUC partition.
The Copy Operation into/from the TTCAN Controller shall be scheduled within a Job List .
If a Job List is used, the TTCAN Job List Execution Function ( JLEF ) shall execute the Communication Jobs of the Job List synchronously to the Controller time (i.e. at well-defined points in time).

The API names of the JLEF shall obey the following pattern: • CanIf_TTJobListExec_0() for Controller # 0 • CanIf_TTJobListExec_1() for Controller # 1 • CanIf_TTJobListExec_2() for Controller # 2 • CanIf_TTJobListExec_3() for Controller # 3 • ... and so on, if more than 4 Controllers are supported.
If the JLEF lost synchronisation to the Local Time of the TTCAN Controller then the function Dem_SetEventStatus(CANIF_TT_E_JLE_SYNC, DEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED) shall be called.
Extended Production Errors of TtcanIf are defined in 7.1.

If a Job List is configured for a Tx L-PDU (see CanIfTTJoblist ), a function call of CanIf_Transmit() (see SWS_CanIf_00318 ) shall not directly call Can_Write() . The information that a call of CanIf_Transmit() occurred has to be buffered within TtcanIf until the data is transmitted by the Job List .

For each Controller that is controlled by TtcanIf one dedicated Job List and one dedicated JLEF (refer to section 7.3) shall be used. It's possible to mixture both variants, with and without the usage of a Job List .
If during JLEF <User_TriggerTransmit>() returns E_NOT_OK , TtcanIf shall not call Can_Write() afterwards.
If the JLEF was executed successfully, then the function Dem_SetEventStatus(CANIF_TT_E_JLE_SYNC, DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PASSED) shall be called.

Starting the package processing UCM shall provide a method ProcessSwPackage to process transferred Software Package. id corresponding to Software Package shall be provided for this method.

Cancelling the package processing On call of Cancel method, UCM shall abort the running package processing task, undo the changes to the Software Cluster for which processing started and free the reserved resources used for it. The Processing State of a Software Package ( processingState) shall transition to kProcessingFailed.

Report software information UCM shall provide a method GetSwClusterInfo of the interface service PackageManagement to provide the identifiers and versions of the SoftwareClusters that are in state kPresent.
Rollback to the software prior to Finish the update process UCM shall provide a method Rollback to recover from an activation that went wrong.
Data transfer at any time UCM shall provide support to transfer Software Packages at any time when UCM is running. Transferring is decoupled from the UCM Package Management states.

Executing the data transfer After successful call of TransferStart method, the transmission of the Software Package block-wise shall be supported by the method TransferData. The Transfer State of a Software Package (transferState) shall stay in kTransferring.
UCM exposing its identifier UCM shall provide a method GetId returning its UcmModuleInstantiation identifier.

End of data transfer After transmission of a Software Package is completed, the transmission can be finished with method TransferExit. The Transfer State of a Software Package( transferState) shall be set to kTransferred.

Sequential Software Package Processing Once method ProcessSwPackage has been called by a client, further calls to the same method shall be rejected with ApplicationError kServiceBusy as long as the processing is still ongoing.

Providing Progress Information UCM shall provide a method GetSwProcessProgress to query the progress of executing the ProcessSwPackage method call for provided TransferId. Parameter progress shall be set to a value representing the progress between 0% and 100% (0x00 ... 0x64).
Status Field of Package Management The global state of UCM shall be provided using the field CurrentStatus
Finishing the packages activation UCM shall provide a method Finish to commit all the changes and clean up all temporary data of the processed Software Packages.
Deleting transferred Software Packages UCM shall provide a method DeleteTransfer that shall delete the targeted Software Package and free the resources reserved to store that Software Package.
Activation of Software Clusters UCM shall activate all the Software Clusters extracted from the Software Packages when Activate is called.
Revert all processed Software Packages UCM shall provide a method RevertProcessedSwPackages to revert all changes done with ProcessSwPackage.
Activation of SoftwareClusters At the invocation of method Activate, UCM shall enable execution of any pending changes from the previously processed Software Packages.

Dependency Check During the Update State (updateState) kActivating, UCM shall perform a dependency check to ensure that all the Software Clusters having dependencies are not missing any necessary Software Cluster as defined by dependsOn and do not conflict towards each other as defined by conflictsTo, otherwise return ApplicationError kDependencyMissing.
Delta Package version applicability Applicable version of SoftwareCluster on which to apply delta shall be included into related SoftwarePackage’s deltaPackageApplicableVersion attribute.
Software Package Authentication UCM shall check authentication of the Software Package or the transferred block before processing it.
